svg.title: A review sequence to prevent names and numbers from changing in AI translation
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
A review sequence to prevent names and numbers from
changing in AI translation
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-25
Mark values that must not change
before translation
First mark people’s names, company names,
product names, addresses, amounts, dates, units,
telephone numbers, and document numbers in the…
Fix proper names with a glossary
Google Cloud Translation’s glossary
documentation explains that a glossary is used
when terms such as product names need to be…
Review numbers by separating value
from format
The key to reviewing numbers is to check
separately whether they are the same numbers and
whether they have the same format.
Compare the translation with the
source line by line
① Check that people’s names retain the same
spelling as in the source. ② Check that company
and product names match the glossary spellings…
